text:
Aisha Patel: Kicking off NebulaWorks onboarding. Quick roll call + any non-negotiable constraints?
Priya Desai: Hi - Priya here (Nebula PM). We're aiming for a pilot by Aug 1. Need SSO and DPA signed before we start heavy integration.
Tom Rivera: Tom (Solutions Eng) — I'll take API integration + data mapping. Rough volume: ~5M tokens/day peak. Any sampling rules or PII redaction we should apply?
Miguel Ortega: Miguel (Onboarding Eng) — noted. We can do a 3-week fast track or a 7-week standard. Recommend standard unless Nebula can guarantee 2 engineers full-time for the fast track.
Jenna Li: Jenna (Enablement) — I'll own enablement: admin + dev sessions, quickstart guide, and a hands-on lab. Prefer to schedule dev deep-dive in week 3.
Aisha Patel: Proposed success criteria: 1) E2E generation pipeline deployed to prod-like sandbox; 2) 10k DAU simulated with <200ms avg latency in sandbox; 3) KB syncer running with <5% error; 4) Team signoff on quality evals and rollout checklist.
Priya Desai: Those look good. Latency target might force Dedicated capacity — can you confirm cost delta and whether caching will be available in sandbox?
Tom Rivera: Dedicated gives stable p95 and KV cache enabled by default. Ballpark +30% unit cost vs hosted for this workload. I'll add a short cost sheet to the shared doc.
onboard-bot: Meeting scheduled: NebulaWorks Kickoff — Jul 10 10:00 PT. Invite sent to attendees.
Miguel Ortega: Primary risks I see: DPA legal review (est 2w), SSO cert exchange + IdP config (1w), data residency checks if they need EU-only storage. If DPA/legal slips >30 days, classify as renewal risk and escalate.
Jenna Li: Enablement checklist I'll deliver: admin guide, runbook, 2 recorded sessions, 1 hands-on lab, and a checklist for support handoff. Will drop templates by EOD.
Aisha Patel: Action items (owners):
- Priya: share legal contact + SSO owner (needed today)
- Tom: upload data schema and a 10k-sample payload to shared drive
- Miguel: provision prod-like sandbox and baseline perf tests
- Jenna: draft enablement plan and dates
Please confirm owners and any blockers. :thumbsup:
Priya Desai: Confirmed — legal is Martin Cole (martin@nebulaworks.com) and SSO owner is Lina Ho (lina@nebulaworks.com). I'll add both to the doc now.
Tom Rivera: I'll upload the schema to the NebulaWorks folder and link it here: https://drive.redwood/nw/schema (will include sample payload).
Aisha Patel: Excellent. I'll update the project tracker with these owners and circulate a short prompt set survey to capture initial evals. Closing the loop after the kickoff meeting. Thanks everyone :cheer:
